# SD18 deterministic Human Sorcerer level 15 widening fixture.
# Widens the accepted SD18 deterministic PF1 Core Rulebook Human Sorcerer
# level-1..level-14 spontaneous spell-burden baseline
# (tests/sd18_sorcerer_level14_widening.rs) to Sorcerer level 15 as chosen
# input only. It names selections; it does not contain derived, computed, or
# parity values. It preserves the accepted Human race-choice seam
# (ability-bonus and bonus-feat), the deterministic ability/feat posture from
# the level-1..level-14 fixtures, and the same canonical bloodline and
# bloodline class-skill selections (Arcane, Knowledge [arcana]), adding only
# the level bump this cycle needs.
#
# It deliberately avoids every later Sorcerer burden surface: no Arcane Bond
# execution, no bloodline arcana, no bloodline feat selection, no bloodline
# bonus spell selection, no spellbook, no which-spells-known selection, no
# spontaneous-casting execution, and no level-16+ progression. The PF1 CRB
# Sorcerer class table's level-15 "Special" column reads "Bloodline power,
# bloodline spell" (verified independently against d20pfsrd and
# aonprd.com, both identical) — a further bloodline power and bloodline
# spell grant, exactly like the level-3/5/7/9/11/13 pattern — but both
# entries are bloodline-specific (varying per chosen bloodline) and neither
# is flat/identity-shaped, so they stay named by the existing Arcane Bond /
# bloodline progression blocker's language, unchanged; no new pillar is
# grounded from the Special column at level 15 either. No genuinely new
# spell-level column opens at level 15 (the 8th-level column stays "—");
# only the already-grounded base-spells-per-day and spells-known arrays
# widen within their existing 7/8-element shapes.
case_id=pf1-crb-human-sorcerer-level15-sd18-widening
source_package_id=pf1.core_rulebook
race_id=race:human
class_level=class:sorcerer:15
ability=strength:8
ability=dexterity:14
ability=constitution:13
ability=intelligence:10
ability=wisdom:12
ability=charisma:17
feat=feat:dodge
choice=choice:sorcerer_bloodline:bloodline:arcane
choice=choice:sorcerer_bloodline_class_skill:knowledge:arcana
choice=choice:human_bonus_feat:feat:dodge
choice=choice:human_ability_bonus:ability:charisma
provenance=programs/codex/requirements/SD-18-core-rules-breadth/scope-draft.md
